who.value: logged-out buyer arriving from a social media ad

stage.value: enquiry on a listing (postListing stage on the map)

job.value: contact the seller about the service listing without logging in

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The buyer phone shows the 'HDB painting · 4-room' listing with 'From $350' and the seller 'Ah Seng Painting', so it reads as an enquire-on-a-listing page.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width green 'WhatsApp' button is by far the strongest element on the buyer phone.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'WhatsApp', 'Chat' and 'Log in' each say where the tap goes.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Nothing beyond everyday words appears; '4.9 · replies in 1h' is self-explanatory.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The only decision is whether to message via WhatsApp, which a logged-out ad visitor can make.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The page keeps to title, price, seller and one CTA, with the number-sharing note as a single small line.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything shown (listing, seller, WhatsApp CTA, 'Log in' fallback) serves a first-time logged-out enquiry.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The one line 'Your number is shared with the seller so they can reply' is the only body text and the CTA carries the action.
